items.description:
Maugene Engineering Services (Pty) Ltd is a steel fabrication and engineering workshop specialising in fabrication, steelwork, gear cutting, laser cutting, and CNC milling and turning. Its work serves the steel manufacturing, agriculture, mining, automotive, chemical and foundry industries, and its product range includes wheel adapters alongside custom fabricated components built to customer specification.

One of Pretoria's oldest privately owned engineering facilities, the company has been operating continuously since 1964, giving it decades of accumulated expertise across the industrial sectors it supplies. Based in Silvertondale, Pretoria, it continues to serve manufacturers and industrial operators across the region, taking on everything from one-off custom components to larger production runs that need precision metalwork produced in-house rather than outsourced piecemeal.

Mega Storage Montana is a basement self-storage facility in Montana Park offering around 60 units ranging from 18 to 72 square metres, including standard brick-walled units and office-style storage for business use. Its standard 3x6 metre (18sqm) unit is priced from roughly R1,045 a month, and the facility also stocks packaging supplies such as boxes, locks and bubble wrap for customers preparing their own move.

The site is protected by 24-hour guards and gives customers 12-hour daily access every day, including weekends and public holidays, and forms part of a wider Mega Storage network that has operated in Pretoria's northern suburbs for more than 30 years, alongside sites in Silverton, Sinoville and Zambezi Junction. Located in Montana Park, it serves households and businesses across the area needing secure, flexible short- or long-term storage close to home.

Midstream Action Sports is an indoor sports arena on Black Korhaan Drive offering Action Cricket, hockey, netball and soccer across three courts, run under the national Action Sports brand that operates more than 20 similar arenas around South Africa. Matches use an electronic scoring system for team and individual statistics, with fixtures generated automatically and a graded league structure running through to quarter-, semi- and grand finals.

All equipment is supplied, and the venue has change rooms, showers, and a kitchen and bar for players and spectators, making it a weekend fixture for local leagues as well as corporate and social bookings. Based in Midstream Estate, Centurion, it also hosts kids' events such as holiday fun days with games and jumping castles, giving families in the area a regular indoor sport and entertainment option.

MineWorks Metallurgy is a metallurgical plant design, engineering and consulting firm that pioneered a 'floating metallurgical technical services office' model, giving mineral project developers, mines and other engineering consultants access to specialist expertise without carrying it in-house. Its services span conceptual and basic process design, front-end engineering, and acting as Owner's Representative or project-management-office for mining clients, built around careful needs identification before a new asset is acquired.

The firm's value proposition centres on managing a client's mineral reserves, processing technology, manpower and capital efficiently so that projects generate strong operational margins as early as possible in their investment horizon, with the flexibility to adjust as a client's business plan changes. Based in Die Hoewes, Centurion, and holding a Level 1 BBBEE rating, it works with mineral project developers and mining companies on plant design and project delivery.

Mugg & Bean Wonderboom Junction serves fresh coffee, all-day breakfast and lunch from Shop G17 in Wonderboom Junction Shopping Centre, part of the Mugg & Bean chain that has traded in South Africa since 1996. Regulars come for dishes such as the Hearty Grill Breakfast and Eggs Benedict alongside gourmet burgers, muffins and cakes made from scratch, with dine-in, takeaway and online ordering all available.

The branch is rated among the higher-scoring restaurants in Pretoria on TripAdvisor, reflecting a consistent standard across its breakfast, brunch and lunch menu. Located in Annlin West, Pretoria, within Wonderboom Junction Shopping Centre, it functions as a neighbourhood meeting spot for coffee and meals, drawing in families, friends and colleagues throughout the day.

NMI Toyota Menlyn is a Toyota dealership on Dallas Avenue in Pretoria East, offering the full new-vehicle range from the Hilux, Fortuner, Corolla Cross and Land Cruiser line-up through to the Starlet, Rumion, Corolla Hatch and performance models such as the GR Corolla, GR Yaris and GR86. Beyond new sales, the dealership runs an Automark used-vehicle operation alongside Toyota Certified Pre-Owned stock, parts, a workshop booking service and trade-in or sell-your-car options.

It operates as part of the NMI group of dealerships, which trades across South Africa and Botswana, giving customers backing from a large, established dealer network. Based in Menlyn, Pretoria East, the dealership is set up for buyers wanting to browse, finance, service and trade in a Toyota under one roof.

items.description:
Omniserve Facility Management is a property and garden services company offering residential and commercial garden maintenance, including lawn care, pruning, edging and weeding, alongside landscaping, commercial cleaning, building maintenance and repairs, waste removal, and weekly pool maintenance that covers cleaning, water testing and chemical balancing. It grew out of the combination of several specialised companies into one comprehensive facility management provider.

Founded in 2010, the business serves homeowners, estates and businesses across Pretoria and Johannesburg with customised, flexible service packages rather than one fixed package for every client. Operating from Brummeria, Pretoria, it covers everything from a single private garden to ongoing maintenance contracts for complexes and commercial properties.

Payteq is a South African software company specialising in electronic payments technology, building systems for authenticated collections, EFT and NAEDO processing, real-time clearing (RTC) and account holder verification. Its platforms are built for and compliant with the BankServ, PASA and SARB banking standards, and the company positions itself as an integration, payment and billing solutions provider for financial institutions and their corporate clients.

Marking more than two decades in the payment technology market, Payteq offers advisory services to help clients optimise their payment workflows as well as customer-specific modification of its products for individual needs. Based in Southdowns Office Park, Irene, Centurion, it serves banks and large corporate clients needing dependable, standards-compliant payment infrastructure rather than off-the-shelf solutions.

Peak Physiotherapy is an owner-led physiotherapy practice in Mayville treating back and neck pain, sports injuries, post-operative rehabilitation, joint pain and muscle strains in both adults and children, including dry needling. Its approach follows a structured four-step process: a thorough assessment and diagnosis to pinpoint the cause of pain, a personalised recovery timeline, a treatment plan built around daily life, sport or post-surgery goals, and hands-on treatment with guided rehabilitation to prevent the problem recurring.

No referral is needed to book an assessment, and medical aid can be billed directly, making the practice an accessible first stop for new injuries as well as ongoing complaints. Located minutes from Life Eugene Marais Hospital in Mayville, Pretoria, it serves patients across the wider Moot area, including Rietfontein, Les Marais, Wonderboom and Waverley.

Philafrica Foods runs a corporate office in Centurion covering finance, treasury, legal, HR and IT functions for its wider group of food-processing businesses. That group spans grain management and milling, animal feed manufacturing, bread and snack production, and oil and protein processing, operating plants across South Africa and into other African countries as part of the broader AFGRI agribusiness network.

AFGRI's divisions also extend into equipment supply, agricultural retail, farmer development training and bulk agricultural logistics, giving the Philafrica office access to a wide base of agribusiness expertise beyond food processing alone. Based in Doringkloof, Centurion, the office supports group-wide operations rather than serving walk-in customers directly.

Plaas Media is an agricultural media company producing written, audio and visual content as well as special projects for the farming sector. It opened in 2010 with five staff members, two magazine titles and a radio programme, and has since grown to around 30 staff producing publications, radio segments, YouTube content and video production for an agricultural audience.

That growth reflects a shift toward covering agriculture across multiple formats rather than a single print title, giving advertisers and readers a range of ways to reach the same farming community. Based in Kloofsig, Centurion, the company continues to serve South Africa's agricultural sector with its mix of 360-degree media output.

Plant Farm Nursery is a wholesale plant nursery that grows its own stock, which keeps its prices competitive on a wide range including succulents, groundcovers, shrubs, trees, aloes, fruit-bearing plants and palms. It does not sell seeds, vegetables or seedlings, focusing instead on established plants for nurseries, landscapers and the general public.

Delivery is available for larger orders or anywhere within Gauteng, charged at a fee, making it practical for customers buying more than will fit in a vehicle, and visits to view available stock can be arranged by appointment. Based on a smallholding in Shere, east of Pretoria, the nursery supplies both trade buyers and home gardeners looking to green an office or outdoor space.

PLTFRM Hazeldean is a family and pet-friendly restaurant built within a restored old calf barn along the Pienaars River in Hazeldean, serving fresh pizzas, sushi, burgers and fireside drinks in a rustic, farmyard-style setting. The space is designed for lingering rather than a quick meal, with long lunches, sunset drinks, morning walks and fireside evenings all part of the experience it offers.

An outdoor play area keeps children entertained while adults relax, and the venue takes table bookings for groups wanting to settle in for an afternoon or evening. Set in Hazeldean Valley, Pretoria, surrounded by open farmland, it draws visitors looking for a slower-paced outing with food, drinks and space to bring the family, including pets.

PSA Signs is an ISO 9001:2015 certified manufacturer and supplier of branded corporate signage, founded in 1989 and working across banking, automotive, forecourt and commercial environments. Its work spans design and technical development that translates brand standards into practical signage specifications, through to manufacturing and installation of lettering, illuminated identities, fabricated signs and graphics.

The company also manages signage rollouts and rebrands across multiple sites for a single client, plus ongoing maintenance and refurbishment of existing signage, with past work including interior and exterior signage and ATM branding for banking clients. Based in Sunderland Ridge, Centurion, it places a strong focus on safety, health, environmental and quality management throughout its projects.

items.description:
Rubber It is a waterproofing specialist trading since 2007, offering roof waterproofing, sealing, roof cleaning, and rust and corrosion protection for residential, commercial and industrial properties. Its service list covers dredging blocked gutters, fixing or replacing corroded roof bolts, skylight waterproofing, and work on IBR and corrugated metal roofs, concrete roof slabs and asbestos roof sheets.

The company also manufactures its own range of rubber waterproof coatings, including the Multi Guard liquid membrane system, giving it control over both the products used and the installation work itself. Based in Daspoort, Pretoria, it has built its track record on thousands of completed waterproofing projects across the region's homes, businesses and industrial sites.

SA Website Designer has been designing websites and marketing online since 2001, building custom WordPress sites that include domain registration and free hosting for the first year. Packages range from e-commerce sites from R4,900 to monthly SEO campaigns from R1,200, with a turnkey approach that handles the technical setup so clients don't have to.

The business has built a 4.9-star reputation from client reviews, with most new sites completed in under five days and support offered over WhatsApp for quick turnaround on questions. Operating from Menlo Park, Pretoria, with over 20 years of web design and internet marketing experience behind it, it serves small businesses wanting an affordable, done-for-them website without ongoing monthly fees.

Shoprite Lotus Gardens is a supermarket on the corner of Ruth First Street and Joe Modise Road, stocking groceries alongside its own bakery and deli counters. As part of the wider Shoprite chain, it carries the retailer's usual grocery range while also serving as a convenient last-minute stop for the surrounding neighbourhood.

The store is one of several Shoprite branches in the area, alongside others in Nkomo, Atteridgeville and Daspoort, giving residents a choice of nearby outlets under the same brand. Located in Lotus Gardens, Pretoria, it remains a regular grocery destination for the local community doing their weekly or daily shopping.

SMEC South Africa's Pretoria office is part of a global engineering, project management and development consultancy with close to 70 years of history, delivering transport, water, energy and built-environment projects. Its specialist capabilities span roads, bridges and highways, rail and metro systems, water and wastewater, energy and renewables, ports and maritime, and urban community infrastructure.

The firm is known for resolving complex design challenges across diverse environments, from dense urban settings to some of the most remote project sites, and operates as part of the Surbana Jurong Group's international network. Based on Albertus Street in La Montagne, Pretoria, the office contributes local delivery capacity to that wider global engineering practice.

Synexus SA Watermeyer Clinical Research Centre is a commercial clinical-trials research site operated by Synexus, described as the world's largest multi-national company specialising in the conduct of clinical trials for international pharmaceutical companies. The centre recruits participants for studies assessing the safety and efficacy of new drugs and investigating new uses for existing ones, across therapeutic areas including cardiovascular, respiratory, CNS, dermatology, allergy, genito-urinary and infectious disease, as well as conditions such as diabetes and kidney disease.

Each study is approved by the South African Medicines Control Council and an independent Ethics Committee before recruitment begins, and the centre is one of Synexus Clinical Research SA's three dedicated sites in the country. Located on Stamvrug Street in Val de Grace, Pretoria, it operates as a research facility rather than a general treatment practice.

items.description:
Umso Construction (Pty) Ltd is a civil engineering and construction firm founded in 1996 through a strategic partnership between a major corporate construction firm and a group of emerging industry professionals. Its services cover road construction and rehabilitation, earthworks and infrastructure, water and sanitation systems, and machinery and equipment investment, built up over three decades into a respected name in South African construction.

Its project footprint spans urban developments and rural service delivery alike, including bridges, schools, healthcare facilities and housing, work the company describes as improving quality of life as well as contributing to economic growth. Headquartered in Highveld, Centurion, it takes on both large public-sector infrastructure contracts and private-sector building projects.

Unlimited Events Group is an event solutions company with more than 25 years of experience, supplying the South African event industry through a catalogue of more than 2,000 hire items spanning dinnerware, tableware, carpets, lighting, staging, props, furniture and soft furnishings. Alongside equipment and furniture rental, it offers event decor and styling, sound and lighting, stretch tents, and full staging and production.

The company also runs team-building programmes, including outdoor, indoor and creative formats, for corporate clients looking to combine an event with staff activities. A Level 1 B-BBEE contributor, Unlimited Events Group is based in Samrand Business Park, Centurion, and works across turnkey and DIY event solutions depending on how much a client wants to manage themselves.

Van Der Linde & Venter Konstruksie, trading as JC van der Linde & Venter Projects (Pty) Ltd, is a construction company structured to take on work ranging from large commercial contracts to minor alterations and additions. Its project experience spans abattoirs and food-processing plants, education and health facilities, industrial warehouses, automotive and petroleum facilities, religious facilities, commercial offices and residential construction.

The company was founded in 2006 following a restructuring of a family construction business that dates back to 1953, giving it a long operating history behind its current structure. It holds BBBEE Level 2 status with 35% black women ownership, and is based in De Wilgers, Pretoria, where it continues to take on projects across the sectors it has long served.

Africa Surge Protection has manufactured lightning surge and voltage spike protection devices since 1991, when it launched with the original Wonder Plug, now a long-established name in the local market. Its products are manufactured to ISO 9001 standards and tested by laboratories including SANS, SABS, Test Africa, Telkom and Intertek, with further independent testing carried out in cooperation with the CSIR.

The current range includes the Wonder Plug alongside WP3, WP4 and WP5 models, the WPCC and WPL Clover and Figure 8 variants, and the WMC and WMCC HiLo, USB and EMI units, giving it one of the most extensive locally manufactured surge protector ranges in Africa. Based in Hennopspark, Centurion, it supplies both household and industrial customers looking to protect electrical and electronic equipment from power surges.

AIDA National Franchises is the head office of the AIDA real estate franchise group, which pioneered real estate franchising in South Africa in 1979. From its Highveld Techno Park base, the head office provides training, management, administrative, technology and marketing support to its network of member agencies, along with tools such as a bond calculator, property search and email alerts for buyers and sellers.

The franchise also runs bank-assisted sales listings and a franchise opportunities programme for agents looking to join under the AIDA brand, positioning the head office as the operational backbone behind its various local branches rather than a branch serving walk-in clients itself. Based in Centurion, it supports agencies operating across South Africa under the AIDA name.

items.description:
Barloworld Toyota Centurion is a Toyota dealership on South Street in the Irene area of Centurion, selling new and used Toyota vehicles alongside other brands sold through the same group, including Hino and Volkswagen. Its showroom typically carries dozens of vehicles in stock, from SUVs and hatchbacks to single and double cab bakkies, giving buyers a wide range of body types and price points to choose from.

The dealership continues to trade under the Barloworld Toyota name even though Barloworld sold its motor retail business to NMI Durban South Motors, which now operates the business as part of its wider NMI group of dealerships. Based in Centurion, it offers new vehicle sales, used stock, and servicing and parts support for Toyota, Hino and Volkswagen owners in the area.

BEAL Group of Companies is a consulting engineering and project management firm offering services across the full project lifecycle, from design and construction through to operations, maintenance and closure. Its specialisms include civil engineering, hydrology and stormwater management, geotechnical engineering, engineering geology, tailings storage facility (TSF) design, structural engineering, electrical installation and contaminated land studies, alongside TSF monitoring and sensor installation.

Founded in the UK in 2003 and established in Africa from 2008, the group now has offices in Pretoria, Thabazimbi and Cape Town as well as Haddenham in the UK, serving the mining, petrochemical and heavy industrial sectors. Based in Hazeldean, Pretoria, its engineers, technologists and technicians also carry out SCPTu and DPSH testing to support geotechnical investigations for clients across these industries.

items.description:
Beyer Group is a network of associated professional firms operating under The Core Group, covering transfer attorneys and conveyancing, accounting and tax, trustee services, bonds and insurance, and property development and estate agency work. Its member entities include Frits Beyer Pty Ltd (chartered accountants), Frits Beyer Inc (registered auditors), Aucamp-Beyer (attorneys and conveyancers), FRB Trust Company (trustee services), Beyer Bonds and Beyer Property Development.

Rather than operating as a single consultancy covering everything the same way, the group positions each entity as a specialist in its own discipline while working together on shared client engagements, aiming to build financial freedom, security and long-term value for clients. Headquartered in Sinoville, Pretoria, it serves clients needing coordinated legal, financial and property services under one umbrella.

Blue Crane Media is a digital marketing and multi-media agency offering SEO, social media marketing, branding, video production, app and web development, and more specialised work such as VR/AR and NFT services. Rather than billing by the hour, the agency works on a subscription points-based system, letting clients draw down services as needed rather than paying per project.

With more than 10 years of experience, it positions itself as a single group covering multiple media disciplines, supported by a wider partner network for additional services and deals. New clients can test a trial points package before committing to an ongoing month-to-month arrangement. Based in Rietvalleirand, Pretoria, it serves businesses wanting ongoing marketing and media support without managing several separate suppliers.

items.description:
Box&Move Furniture Moving Company handles residential and commercial furniture removals across Pretoria, Johannesburg, Centurion and Midrand, with services that extend to packing, unpacking and full office setup for business relocations. That range means the same company can handle a single household move or a larger commercial office relocation without bringing in a separate contractor for each part of the job.

Alongside its removals service, the company runs a box shop selling moving boxes, bubble wrap, tape and mattress covers, giving customers packing their own move a source for supplies without needing a separate stop. Based in Moreleta Park, Pretoria East, it serves households and businesses across the wider Pretoria and Johannesburg region looking for removals support, packing materials, or both.

Brunel Laboratoria (Pty) Ltd is a pharmaceutical company that manufactures and distributes medicines and medical devices under South African Pharmacy Council and SAHPRA licences. It manages more than 100 products and brands, supplying over 1,700 clients every month through registered pharmacies and authorised retailers from a custom-built, temperature- and access-controlled distribution centre of around 1,800 square metres.

With more than 2,200 active customer accounts on its books, the company has built a sizeable distribution footprint within South Africa's pharmaceutical supply chain over the years. Based in Sunderland Ridge, Centurion, it operates as a manufacturing and wholesale link between registered products and the pharmacies and retailers that sell them on to consumers.

Business Dynamics Consultants (Pty) Ltd is an organisational consulting firm combining expertise in human resources, psychology and industrial psychology to help organisations manage performance and reduce stress-related problems. Its services include organisational climate and wellness assessments, psychometric testing, onboarding monitoring and psychological fitness screening, delivered through tools such as its South African Psychological Fitness Index (SAPFI).

The firm works with partners such as Afriforte on instruments including the Afriforte OBM Instrument and the Afriforte Organisational Human Factor Benchmark, giving it a set of proprietary measurement tools beyond generic consulting advice. Based in Elarduspark, Pretoria, it serves organisations wanting data-driven insight into workforce wellbeing and performance rather than one-off training interventions.

Carlton Cafe Delicious is a daytime cafe and delicatessen in Menlo Park Centre, serving breakfast, brunch and lunch made from fresh, seasonal ingredients across indoor and outdoor seating. Its attached deli sells confectionery, take-home meals and locally-sourced products, with made-to-order items such as tart tatines, lasagne, pies, salads and signature cheesecakes available with three days' notice.

A gourmet picnic basket for two, complete with biodegradable plates and bamboo cutlery, is also available for customers wanting a ready-made outing rather than a sit-down meal, and the cafe caters for events as well. Trading since 2002 on 13th Street in Menlo Park, Pretoria, it has built a herb garden around the building and a following among locals looking for a relaxed daytime meal.

items.description:
Casa de Ross is a guest house set in the foothills of the Magaliesberg mountain range near Rosslyn and Wonderpark Shopping Centre, offering a swimming pool, braai facilities and an in-house dining hall that can seat up to twenty guests for breakfast, lunch or dinner, with special dietary requirements catered for on request.

Secure parking is available for up to fifteen vehicles, and the property can help arrange transport for guests needing an easier commute to nearby places. The guest house aims to give visitors a taste of local life, from the surrounding scenery to shared meals in its dining hall. Based in Amandasig, Akasia, it offers a relaxed base for visitors wanting a pool, braai area and communal dining rather than a standard hotel room.

CAT Ink and Toners (Pty) Ltd supplies brand-new, quality compatible ink and toner cartridges for home and business printers, trusted by more than 2,000 clients across South Africa. Free nationwide delivery is available on orders over R500, with same- or next-day delivery in Gauteng, expert cartridge-matching advice for customers unsure which product they need, and support available over WhatsApp.

A loyalty rewards programme gives customers 10% off their first and fifth toner purchase and a free ninth toner, and a replacement policy covers any cartridge that doesn't perform as expected. Operating from a home base in Wingate Park, Pretoria, the business focuses on affordable, reliable printer consumables rather than wider office equipment or hardware sales.

ChrisnelSA is a skills development provider specialising in electric and hybrid vehicle (EV/HEV/PHEV) technician training and quality management systems training, operating from Automotive Supplier Park in Rosslyn. Alongside its training programmes, the company runs an EV/HEV/PHEV service centre, giving it a practical workshop setting to pair with its classroom-based courses.

The company is IMI-certified and counts Toyota, Ford and Johnson Controls among its clients, and operates as the South African arm of G.I.S. Chrisnel, which also has a base in Eching, Germany. Based in Rosslyn, Pretoria, it serves automotive businesses needing their technicians trained and certified to work safely on electric and hybrid vehicles.

Communica is a wholesale and retail distributor of electronic components and equipment, selling semiconductors, connectors, electromechanical parts and passive components alongside IoT and home automation kits, robotics and prototyping products, test and measurement equipment, 3D printers, sensors and tools. It serves makers, engineers, educators and businesses across the automotive, electrical, automation, mining and process-control industries.

Beyond retail sales, the company runs courses and workshops to build practical skills in electronics and emerging technology such as IoT, and supplies technical and tertiary educational institutions as part of its customer base. Trading from Pretoria Central, it functions as both a parts supplier for hobbyists and a components distributor for industrial and educational buyers.

Cornel Botha Attorneys is a Pretoria law firm specialising in deceased estate administration, including insolvent estates, along with will preparation, the creation of inter vivos trusts, and estate litigation such as disputes over the validity of a will or the removal of an executor. Administration of estates is the firm's core focus, and it works to finalise estates as quickly as the process allows.

Several of its staff previously worked within the Department of Justice, including time at the Master of the High Court, giving the practice direct experience of how estates are assessed and administered from the other side of the process. Based in Brummeria, Pretoria, the firm takes on both straightforward estate administration and more complex, disputed cases.
